officialRef.pdf: 中考第3辑初中时文阅读提分训练3+X第3辑中考答案.pdf

q1.explanationZh: 黑咖啡就是不加任何配料（②）；第五段说它味道又浓又苦（④）；第三段说喝黑咖啡的人越来越少（⑥）。所以选 ②④⑥。

evidence.quote: I just ask for ‘coffee’ without any extras

q2.explanationZh: Wicker 说想点杯普通黑咖啡，却要回答店员一连串问题（20个问题），所以选 C。

evidence.quote: But this has become impossible without going through a round of 20 questions with the barista

q3.explanationZh: 文中说星巴克有80%的顾客会加奶、糖等，80%比四分之三（75%）还多，所以选 D。

evidence.quote: 80 per cent of customers add milk, sugar, or other extras to their coffee

q4.explanationZh: 第五段直接说 Howard Schultz 现在还是更爱喝黑咖啡。

evidence.quote: He still prefers his coffee black.

q5.explanationZh: 第六段说店员希望更多顾客能欣赏最纯粹的咖啡，也就是黑咖啡，所以他们建议顾客试试黑咖啡。

evidence.quote: They wish more customers could appreciate the chain’s coffee in its purest form.
